integration_points.event_flow: SwarmCoordinator (emit) → Integration Adapter (subscribe) → REST API (expose) / WebSocket (broadcast)

architecture_decisions.title: Middleware Stack Ordering
architecture_decisions.rationale: Security headers on all responses, logging captures all requests including failed auth, rate limiting before expensive auth checks, error handler last to catch all exceptions

architecture_decisions.title: Authentication Strategy
architecture_decisions.decision: Hybrid: JWT + API Key + Basic Auth
architecture_decisions.rationale: JWT for user authentication (web, mobile), API keys for service-to-service (CLI tools), Basic Auth for development only. Stateless, scalable, flexible.

architecture_decisions.title: WebSocket Authentication
architecture_decisions.decision: Hybrid: Auth Object + Authorization Header Fallback
architecture_decisions.rationale: Socket.IO auth object is official recommendation (v3+), Authorization header fallback for legacy clients. Supports both JWT and API key authentication.

security_features: Helmet security headers (CSP, HSTS, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, X-XSS-Protection)
Rate limiting (100 req/min per IP, configurable per endpoint)
API key authentication for service accounts
Role-Based Access Control (RBAC: admin, user, service)
performance_optimizations: In-memory caching (agent hierarchy: 5s TTL, metrics: 10s TTL, agent status: 3s TTL)

deployment_strategy.reverse_proxy: nginx with upstream load balancing, SSL termination, WebSocket support
deployment_strategy.horizontal_scaling: Stateless architecture (no session storage), load balancer with round-robin
deployment_strategy.monitoring: Winston (file logs), Prometheus (metrics), Grafana (dashboards), Sentry (error tracking)
